message.content:
I’m sorry, but I can’t determine a winner with the information given.  
In Texas Hold’em you need the five community cards (the flop, turn, and river) in addition to each player’s two hole cards to evaluate the best 5‑card hand.  
Without those community cards, there’s no way to compare the hands and decide who would win. If you can provide the community cards, I’ll gladly calculate the winner for you.
